# Proverbs 25 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 25:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | [The]-heavens for-height and-[the]-earth for-depth, and-[the]-heart-of kings — there-is-no-searching. |
| LOGOS | As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the heart of kings is unsearchable. |
| PNEUMA | The sky is high, the earth is deep, and the heart of a king is impossible to fathom. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 25:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Remove [the]-wicked before a-king, and-his-throne will-be-established in-righteousness. |
| LOGOS | Take away the wicked from the presence of the king, and his throne will be established in righteousness. |
| PNEUMA | Remove wicked advisors from the king's presence and his rule will be established on justice. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-honor-yourself before a-king, and-in-[the]-place-of great-ones do-not-stand, |
| LOGOS | Do not put yourself forward in the king's presence or stand in the place of the great, |
| PNEUMA | Don't promote yourself in front of the king or claim a seat among the powerful, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-go-out to-contend hastily, lest — what will-you-do in-its-end, when-your-neighbor puts-you-to-shame? |
| LOGOS | Do not hastily bring into court, for what will you do in the end, when your neighbor puts you to shame? |
| PNEUMA | Don't rush to take your neighbor to court — you might be embarrassed by how it ends. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Your-case plead with-your-neighbor, but-[the]-secret-of another do-not-reveal, |
| LOGOS | Argue your case with your neighbor himself, and do not reveal another's secret, |
| PNEUMA | If you have a dispute, settle it directly with the other person. Don't drag someone else's secrets into it, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Lest [the]-one-hearing puts-you-to-shame, and-your-evil-report does-not-return. |
| LOGOS | Lest he who hears you bring shame upon you, and your ill repute have no end. |
| PNEUMA | Or the person who hears will turn on you, and you'll never live down the disgrace. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
